_whose: This file belongs to the person who runs Granite Record, like bill_notes.json and docket_corrections.json. Claude drafted the rows below on 5 October 2026 from the saved copy of the source page (private/ballotpedia_nh_ballot_measures_2026-10-05.txt), for that person's review. Read them; the file is yours.
_what: The statewide vote on each constitutional amendment both chambers sent to the voters, one row per CACR: the general election it went to, how the source lists it, and the Yes and No votes cast on it. Copied by hand from the source each row names. No generator writes this file, and preflight fails if any build_* or fetch_* script opens it for writing (HANDMADE).
_why: The General Court's docket records the voters' answer for nine of these amendments ('AMENDMENT FAILED REFERENDUM(278,998-178,817)') and for the eight since 2006 records nothing after the second chamber's vote, so those read 'went to the voters' with no answer. The voters' answer is public record, and this is where it comes from.
_how: An amendment needs two thirds of the votes cast on it (Part II, Article 100; the source: 'an amendment needs to receive support from two-thirds (66.67%) of the votes cast on the measure'). The build works the outcome out from yes and no against two thirds and does not read one from here: several of these won a majority and failed. A row with yes and no null is an election still to come.

_fields.term: The CACR's term, as everywhere else on the site.
_fields.bill: The CACR's number, as data/bills.json writes it.
_fields.election: The day of the state general election it went to, as the source dates it.
_fields.label: The source's Title column for the measure, as written: 'Question 1' where the source lists it that way, 'CACR 13' for 2012, and the source's own name for it where it gives no question number.
_fields.described: The source's description of the measure, abridged only where noted, for checking the match.
_fields.yes: Votes for, from the source's Yes Votes column.
_fields.no: Votes against, from the source's No Votes column.
_fields.source: The page the figures were read from.
_fields.match: Why this measure is this CACR: its title, the election its own text names, and the docket row that sent it (or recorded the referendum).
